subject: [PATCH v9 11/32] mm: make PMD migration-entry splitting explicit

2026-11-05.patch_summary: This patch refactors the PMD migration-entry splitting logic in the Linux kernel to make it more explicit and easier to understand. The 'freeze' boolean parameter in functions like __split_huge_pmd() is renamed to 'to_migration_entries', which indicates that it controls whether PTE migration entries are created instead of regular PTE mappings. A new function, split_pmd_to_migration_entries(), is introduced for the only caller that wants this behavior, and assertions are added to ensure that only present or device-private PMDs are handled by __split_huge_pmd_locked(). The patch aims to improve code clarity without introducing any functional changes.
